text: Plant cells perform cellular respiration in mitochondria and release usable energy from glucose.
Plants carry out both photosynthesis and cellular respiration; the processes serve different roles.
Compare photosynthesis with respiration: photosynthesis stores energy in glucose while respiration releases usable energy.
Plants build sugars from carbon dioxide and water using light energy rather than absorbing ready-made food from soil.
Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose.
A seedling receives minerals from soil but produces carbohydrate through photosynthesis in its leaves.
An object can continue moving at constant velocity without a net force when opposing forces are negligible.
Net force changes velocity; it is not required merely to maintain constant velocity.
A puck gliding nearly friction-free continues moving after the push ends because its velocity does not require a continuing net force.
For unit fractions with the same numerator one a larger denominator means each part is smaller.
One third is greater than one fifth because dividing the same whole into three equal parts makes larger pieces than dividing it into five.
Compare fractions using a common whole and reason about piece size before comparing denominator numerals.
A statistical association alone does not establish that one variable caused the other because confounding and reverse causation may remain.
Causal claims require a defensible identification strategy or experimental design beyond correlation alone.
When only association is supported use language such as is associated with instead of causes.
A while loop checks its condition before the body runs so it can execute zero times.
If x starts at 5 then while x less than 3 does not execute even once.
Trace the condition before the first iteration to decide whether a while loop runs at all.
For independent coin flips previous outcomes do not make tails more likely on the next fair flip.
After ten heads a fair coin still has probability one half of tails on the next independent flip.
Separate long-run balance from the probability of the next independent event.
Temperature measures thermal state while total thermal energy also depends on the amount and properties of matter.
A large bucket of warm water can contain more thermal energy than a tiny cup of hotter water.
Compare temperature with total thermal energy by considering both temperature and quantity of matter.
